clips.title: The story
paras: With newly forged weapons in hand, you are directed back from Stranglethorn Vale to the Blasted Lands. The spirit of the Fallen Hero of the Horde awaits your return to set you against the demon Razelikh.

Following the completion of your enchanted armaments, Galvan the Ancient proclaims that the hour of redemption is at hand. You carry the newly crafted weapons back to the Blasted Lands, seeking out the Fallen Hero of the Horde. The ghostly warrior asks whether you are prepared to face Razelikh and his minions.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The hour of redemption is near, friend. You must return to the Blasted Lands with your new-found weaponry and speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde to receive your final objective.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You look battle hardened, friend. Are you prepared to face Razelikh and his minions?
